rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Microsoft Teams MCP server that enables direct integration with Teams chats, channels, and team management through the Microsoft Graph API. Built with Azure MSAL authentication and device code flow for secure access, it provides tools for listing recent chats, reading message history, sending messages to both one-on-one and group conversations, managing team channels, and creating new chats and teams. The implementation handles token caching for seamless authentication and supports comprehensive Teams operations including channel message posting and team creation.
